body: The built CLI imported @sati/core/name at runtime, so sati died in every project when packages/core/dist was missing. Bundle @sati/* and prove the built files import none of them.

completion.releaseNote: The installed sati command no longer fails with "Cannot find module" when the workspace build output is missing.
completion.summary: The CLI build now inlines @sati/* (deps.alwaysBundle in tsdown.config.ts), so the installed sati command no longer imports packages/core/dist at runtime and keeps working when the workspace build output is cleaned. Test: "the built CLI does not import workspace packages at runtime" in packages/cli/test/version.test.ts. Gate green (lint, typecheck, knip, test). Pushed as 9334c42.

title: CLI bundle includes the product name
